question: In 1945, _________ Government came to power in Britain and committed itself to granting independence to India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Labour Party**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Clement Attlee was the Prime Minister of Britain at the time of the Independence of India.
 
• Clement Attlee was the former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.
 
 
• He served as the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1945 to 1951.
 
• He was the leader of the Labour Party in the United Kingdom from 1935 to 1955.
 
 
 
• Clement Attlee had declared India will get independence before June 1948.
 
 
• He declared that the British would quit India in June 1948 on February 20, 1947.
 
• Mountbatten arrived in India on 22 March 1947 as per the instruction of Clement Attlee.
 
• The Indian independence bill was introduced in Parliament on 4th July 1947.
 
• The Indian independence act was enacted on 18th July 1947.
 
• The Indian independence act came into force on 15th August 1947.
 
 
 
• He considered Indian independence as his finest achievement.
